rationale: The Latin anchor *pallor* denotes an unnatural, pathological pallor (as seen in illness or distress), and the attestations are from herbal/medical texts (Leechdoms), strongly suggesting a symptomatic, abnormal lack of skin color rather than a natural light complexion or general colorlessness. This aligns best with lividness.n.01, which specifically covers unnatural lack of color in the skin from sickness.
